verifications.note: A DatacenterDynamics article from May 2025 quotes TC Energy's chief executive saying the Northwoods project on the ANR system is designed to serve electric generation demand in the US Midwest, including data centers. It names no single campus.

records.researcher_notes: TC Energy's chief executive said, as reported by DatacenterDynamics in May 2025, that the Northwoods project is designed to serve power generation demand in the Midwest, including data centers. No specific data center campus or shipper is named, so this is medium confidence.
